$comment: Spec 28 section 9.6 labelled-sample format. Ground truth, NOT a judgement of any one proposal: `referenceName` is what the module/function is really called, so the same sample grades any backend. Labels here are derived mechanically from the bundle's own sourcemap (tests/fixtures/bundles/react-navigation-example-0.85.3/react-navigation-example.map), which is shipped with the fixture and is authoritative for this app; `tests/gate/llm-readability/quality.test.ts` re-checks every `source` against that map, so a stale entry fails the gate rather than rotting. Register-level labels are added in landing 1 from the debug bundle (react-navigation-example.debug.hbc carries debug info); the module/function entries below are what can be labelled without a decompile.

targets.note: the example app's own entry module; the only /example/src module in the bundle
holds the navigation state root and the container ref
hook module; the filename must be the hook it exports
reducer-shaped router: action types are string literals, strong evidence
sibling of StackRouter; a backend that names both the same is inconsistent
factory module named for its default export
context provider component; PascalCase is required by the skill
deep-link URL intake: a trust boundary. A wrong or flattering name here is the misrepresentation class spec 28 section 7 requires zero of
single pure exported helper; the easiest class of module to name
dev-only validator; carries a long warning string literal as evidence
action creator returning {type: "NAVIGATE", payload}; the literal names it
hook whose body registers listeners keyed by event type
